experiment_type: direct affordance ablation within the SLA hybrid
objective: Give the immutable in-turn Grep evidence artifact a fair behavioral test by making it the first retrieval action instead of leaving a buried optional output mode the model never selects.

held_constant.split: visible Harvey LAB dev tasks only

reference: H7 sla_hybrid. Its white-collar cell skipped the compiler because the model emitted an artifact with empty chat text; preserve that cell as an implementation-failure receipt and rerun it after the shared gate fix.
candidate_difference: After deriving the Spec, the first retrieval call must be Grep output_mode=working_set with a targeted union regex derived from the checklist.
The model must Read the returned immutable in-turn path before returning to exact source sections for gaps or verification.
Universal dot patterns are explicitly excluded; a second non-overlapping set is allowed only for truncation or remaining checklist gaps.
shared_fairness_fixes_applied_before_can: Run the automatic compiler when an artifact exists even if chat text is empty.
Audit the artifact alone when one exists rather than concatenating status chat text.
Remove already-opened domains from the refreshed discovery schema.
Exclude reads of generated artifacts from original-source exposure metrics.
primary_observations: whether the first retrieval call creates a working set and the model reads it
working-set manifest size, units, documents, truncation, original-source union, and later gap-filling reads
native LAB score and valid artifact
tool-result/context bytes, input/cache/output tokens, calls, rounds, replay, and latency
whether the bounded projection omits material issues or reduces giant Grep/whole-read behavior
interpretation_policy: The working-set-first instruction is the intended treatment. Shared correctness fixes are disclosed, so historical H7 differences are not a perfectly isolated causal estimate. A feature that is merely present but receives zero calls is not treated as tested.
non_goal: Cross-turn or restart persistence. The candidate is an immutable turn-local source projection that survives provider rounds and the SLA correction checkpoint; do not call it a durable stored artifact.
